consequence.statement: Only a typo in the migration docs was fixed; there is no operational consequence for an operator.

original.statement: A typo in the migration documentation was fixed; this has no operational subject for operators.

decision.reason: [ev-bc4c31dbfaa7] lists this change under the Documentation section of the v3.0.0 changelog as "Fix typo in migration docs". A typo fix in the docs doesn't change how the product behaves, so an operator who does nothing is unaffected. The proposed consequence, kind none (informational, low severity), matches that.
